commit.message:
Be more explicit about fortress crab's ego-doubling effect (Acrobat)

In the talisman description (the mutation screen was already plenty
explicit).

There is a mild ongoing awkwardness where the detailed description of many
bespoke form properties are only available if you actually put the talisman
on. Some of them are hard to shoehorn into the item description without
being either vague or incredibly wordy. I wonder if there's any way to
make those popup sub-descriptions accessible from the item itself?

Fix TSO's holy warrior summon lasting 1/10th as long as intended (acrobat)

Turns versus aut strikes again.
Fix comment typo.

Fix Trog's Hand tooltip (dolorous)

status_light_description assumed no spaces in the status text. We need to
special case Trog's Hand so that it pulls up the correct db entry.

Fixes #3821.

Make derived undead monsters use the original head count

Previously, spectral and zombie hydra/slymdra used the head count of
their live version on death, while yred's bound soul rerolled the head
count.

Using the version on death is slightly problematic because it
incentivises head farming - especially for the more permanent bound
souls. So we standardise these to use the original head count of the
hydra.

Fixes #4115

New unrands for the 'new' armour egos (#5423)

- +8 Arcane Splint Mail, a chainmail unrand that grants Archery and
coronas enemies hit by projectiles (even thrown items, if you are allergic to
using archery).
- +6 bone scales, a Death pds modified to have plate level encumbrance
(so it gives plate stats while being wearable by offsize species, sort of
like armour of Talos but in a more useful way). Also grants a bunch of other
properties, but banes on equip.
- +12 Forgewarden's cuirass, a Resonance plate that comes with an enhancer
but reduces piety gain because it was blasphemously devoted to a certain god
that does not exist.

commit.message: Fix Homebrew's GitHub Actions reference

Let the player know where they've been shafted

This can be useful to know, e.g. when deciding whether to explore more
of the dungeon before doing lair/orc. So we add an indicator for which
branches you've been shafted in, which also serves the purpose of
(somewhat) explaining this mechanic exists.

Fix a couple more things involving known-invisible monsters

They should now be accounted for by nearby enemy checks for reading
scrolls and warnings for inadequate space when trying to summon things.

Fix being unable to attack known-invisible monsters when stationary (Ge0FF)

(Without using ctrl+direction or autofight, at least.)
Fix punctuation.

Add another adjective to gizmos; fix a comment.

(The names of both cobalt and nickel reference luckless German miners
versus goblins.)
Add a few more gizmo adjectives.

Rework death ego (#5412)

It was a bit too narrow and very unpopular.

Remove the hp loss on casting non-necro spells, reduce the wizardry
bonus, and provide a chance to drain some HP from adjacent enemies when
casting a necro spell. Maybe more interesting/better.

commit.message: fix tense

Make newly enchanted wpns/armour use proper tiles

(This is the same idea as #5177, but implemented differently; it marks
newly enchanted items using item_set_appearance(), the same way that
newgame_make_item() does with enchanted items the player starts with.
Thus, such items are marked as either glowing or runed.)
Checkwhite.

Remove a redundantly set parameter.

Since effect is already true by default in monster::del_ench(), we don't
need to explicitly set it to true when removing the haunted enchantment
from a pacified monster.

Remove bullseye target from pacified monsters.

So that you don't keep shooting a monster you pacify under Ely, or an
orc you convert through violence under Beogh.

Closes #5415.

Remove obsolete Yredelemnul piety hint.

It hasn't applied since Yredelemnul was revamped to use traditional
piety in 18fcfa0.

Externalise remaining hint text

[Committer's note: Squashed and edited commit message, removed a few
unneeded blank lines, fixed one missing period.]
Fix typos.

Buff Archery ego (again)

Add a little bit (1%) bonus ranged damage per level of armour skill.

This commit also refactors the resonance damage mod for clarity.

Fix monster Searing Ray sometimes continuing a turn while confused (Dossy)

The check for interruptions was done before clouds affect a monster on
their turn, meaning that it was possible for a Searing Ray caster to get
confused by a meph cloud and still continue their spell for one more turn
before noticing they were confused.

Instead, check for interruptions at the moment it tries to continue the
spell.

(Also, do a little refactoring of other similar interruption checks in
general.)

This fixes #5411

Allow summoned monsters to generate with throwing nets

Now that this scenario no longer needs to be avoided (as of the previous
commit), there's no reason to ban summoned gnolls from having nets.

Fix handling of summoned throwing nets (Flugkiller)

Throwing nets held by summoned monsters operated as if they were real, but
would spam the log with debug errors once one actually landed on the ground
(since summoned objects are supposed to disappear as soon as a monster
stops holding them).

This problem was mostly avoided in past by not giving throwing nets to
summoned monsters at all (if, say, the player got one via ?summoning), but
if Bane of Multiplicity cloned a monster with a net, the summoned clone
would also have nets. This was probably also possible via other means to
clone monsters as well.

Now thrown nets by summoned monsters will be treated properly as 'fake' net
(similar to how net traps work), disappearing whenever they would hit the
ground but otherwise functioning properly.

Fix aqua form + axes interaction (Ogregutan)

Since 083d3cb, when use of targeter_cleave was restored, aqua form lost its
ability to reach with cleaving weapons. This commit restores that (as well
as explicating on v that you cleave in melee range even when reaching
further away.)

Make shopkeeper names more random

They have three random bytes, but only used two of them, limiting us to
only 40,000 possible shopkeeper names.

To preserve existing names, existing shops copy their second byte into
their (previously unused) third byte.

Apply crab form bonus to resonance and command

Also to the fire and ice scale unrands' school wizardry (can revert if
unwanted).

Death ego is unchanged because it is probably getting reworked soon.

Rework resonance ego. (#4940)

Resonance ego now increases damage only when meleeing something adjacent to 
one of your constructs. The damage has been increased to its old value of 2% per 
Forgecraft skill level. Positional Gameplay tm.

commit.message: Remove an extra space in a message

Display "master archer" in xv

Let players know in advance when a monster is allowed to shoot in melee range.

Fix typo: warps -> wraps.

Since the bolas is described as wrapping elsewhere.
Fix typo.
Remove Armataur from aptitudes list

Add !lig's new rN+++ to stash search.

Closes #5409.
remove extraneous comma

Unrands for 'special' weapon brands (#5398)

Adds unrands for the specialty weapon brands of each weapon type.
I have tried to double down on the brand gimmick where possible, in addition
to rounding out unused base types (gsc, short sword, scimitar, and bardiche).

- The giant spiked club "Carina at Dusk," a +9 concussive GSC that spawns a 
shooting star when knocking an enemy back, and 1/4th of the time otherwise.
Really high damage, really able to push stuff.
- The coolibah bardiche, a +6 entangling bardiche that can apply flooded status
and/or put a bog under constricted enemies. Doesn't matter what the constrict
source is, so feel free to combine it with a wand of roots. Locking enemies in 
place over a bog should feel rewarding, though fliers are immune of course.
- The Staff of Five Virtues, a +5 lajatang of rebuke that provides additional 
base SH when certain strategic thresholds are met, and gives reflection and 
an extra block if at least three thresholds are. Can turn the xp savings of
using a lajatang into a huge amount of defensive power.
- The Stagehand's Sword, a +7 devious short sword that sometimes grants
temporary invisibility, depending on how devious you are. Ideally can let you
chain together stabs to stack max devious easily, but won't start the chain for 
you.
- Hana's Scimitar, a +10 scimitar of valour that additionally grants archmagi
when your MP is 80% full or more. Please enjoy a big opening burst of damage
on your "hybrid" "battlemage" or "wide" characters.
- in lieu of a new axe, the Wrath of Trog gains a sundering brand, which is
able to activate faster than normal and maintain some of its charge through
non-attacks if you are berserk (and behaves as normal sundering if you aren't 
berserk). Its other properties are unchanged. This version of Wrath of Trog 
should explode the screen very nicely if you're berserking.

All of the new unrands are using palette swapped default tiles for now.
Naturally, balance may be adjusted in the future.

commit.message:
Fix a bug with david_glass_crypt

The pressure plates weren't disappearing due to calling the wrong feature name.
fix minor staff desc typo

Show status tooltips in local tiles

This adds tooltips similar to those in webtiles (except they don't do
formatting).

It also makes very small fixes to the text of tooltips on both platforms
(fixing the string for no description + expiring, and trimming the
string).

Replace a std::map.emplace with an insert

CAO doesn't tolerate such new-fangled methods

Fix a bug with penance titles

Good gods don't penance you unless you join an evil (or chaotic with Zin) god
but were applying the traitor title regardless of religion if you abandoned for
any non-good god. Rather annoying, since the penance would last forever in that
case and prevent getting any other title. Check that wrath is active for good
god penance titles to avoid this behavior.

Improve magical staff description (Ix-risor) (#5403)

Display magical staff damage and activation chance beneath the damage
rating line.

Additionally, adjust which Ru skill sacrifices change messaging. Before,
we gave a message about not being able to fully use the staff when the
staff school was sacrificed even though you could get bonus staff damage
from evocations alone, and we didn't give a message for sacrifice
artifice, which completely prevents bonus staff damage even though you
could otherwise get it from the magic school alone. We now display a
special message only for sacrifice artifice instead.

Closes #5009.

commit.message:
Display frenzy's increased melee damage on xv again

After eedf646 compressed the frenzied status's might and berserk effects
into itself, lacking either made the monster xv screen not display the
increased melee damage of monsters; this fixes it by adding frenzy to the
same spot might and berserk adjust displayed melee damage.

Remove an obsolete safety check

Stabs no longer wake monsters, so the path that led to this guard is
gone (and I can see no other possible way calculating damage can kill a
monster)

Remove stale comments about spectral weapons

Removes various comments obsoleted by 95c4dbd.

I think it is still possible to hit the defensive checks these comments
refer to - pacified monsters on stairs do it. These are hard to achieve
as the monsters usually just go up stairs without standing on them, but
it is certainly doable in wizmode and I reckon probably with dispersal
traps.

Move spectral weapon removal into remove_summons (DracoOmega)

This makes the weapons get properly removed in cases such as charming
(whereas previously they would stick around with their owner's old
attitude).

Remove spectral weapons when unequipping the Glaive of the Guard

It sneakily lacks the spectral brand.

Prevent orphaned spectral weapons

Previous to this commit, it was possible to have spectral weapons with
no summoners, which would be cleaned up by handle_behaviour. This was a
bit unexpected - unsuspecting callers trying to alert a monster could
end up with that monster unexpectedly dying. Example times this happened
included when banishing a monster and, prior to the parent commit, when
the monster was disarmed.

In this commit, we make sure we remove any spectral weapon summoned by a
monster as soon as that monster gets cleaned up (at the same place in
the code that we clear up their summons), and so no longer need this
special cleanup step in handle_behaviour. We also stop spectral weapons
from following the player up and down stairs (which they would
previously do without their owner, though their cleanup made this hard
to notice).

In the usual case this is a no-op; monsters who die in the normal way
and are still holding their spectral weapon already dismissed it on
death.

Don't create spectral weapons from dropped weapons

We were creating spectral weapons from weapons the monster had dropped
if they were disarmed in the same attack, due to fineff ordering.

Fix off-by-one in reaching range check (Odds).

It was 1 higher than it should have been, which made all dancing
weapons erroneously display as polearms in console mode due to
erroneously calculating a reach range of at least 2.

Closes #5404.

Reduce cases of allies just glaring at unreachable foes (ogregutan, Odds)

If a foe came into view of the player, while an ally existed that couldn't
yet see that foe, and that foe was unreachable to them (eg: behind grates),
said ally would often freeze in place and refuse to approach - even when
commanded to attack the enemy directly.

The issue is that allies can get foes fed to them based on player vision,
and when their foe isn't in LoS, they attept to perform pathfinding on
them. When that (correctly) failed to find a path, they would... just stand
still.

Instead, set their target to the foe's position, which should make them
try to approach as close as they can get (which is the behavior that
hostile monsters already have in most similar cases).

Fix Hep permanent ability default letters

Following 9183a2, recall/transference/idealise moved from abc to aef, as
bcd were being reserved for class selection (though class selection
didn't actually use them).
Add another Singing Sword line.

Improve shaft self description

Mention that you can't use it on stairs or in water.

Add another word to Crazy Yiuf speech.

Taken from Mark Twain's "Extract from Captain Stormfield's Visit to
Heaven."

Remove redundant "the" in ghost descriptions.

Since the ghost's title should have whatever article is needed already.

Be more explicit about Fedhas plant move speed

It adds 5 aut to a normal speed move, so explicitly call it slow.

Show TRJ destruction for remembered walls

This makes autoexplore work better if the loot vaults had been seen, and
also just looks a bit cooler.

Tag a sealed area no_item_gen and no_monster_gen

Closes #5318.
Add pumpkincat to CREDITS.

Increase chance of Xom orb flavor text

The odds of Xom generating an orb are already quite low,
so an additional 25% chance of printing the unique flavor text
would seem excessive.

Remove unnecessary god_acting call

The function _xom_make_item calls god_acting to update global state,
but the only path by which this function is called goes through
xom_take_action, which already does this.

Fix unreachable Xom flavor text

The function _xom_make_item has unique flavor text for when Xom
gifts the player an orb.
Previously, this flavor text was only emitted when the arguments
to _xom_make_item specifically indicated an orb.
However, _xom_make_item is only ever called from one place,
with arguments of OBJ_RANDOM, so this flavor text was unreachable.
Fix this by inspecting the type of the object that is ultimately
generated, rather than the function arguments.

[Committer's notes: Don't set up the item_def used to inspect the
generated object until after the item is actually generated. The item
could be destroyed if you're over lava when Xom tries to gift it, in
which case inspecting it is useless.]
Fix typo in xom_event_data documentation

Don't claim two-handed weapons will be slowed by a shield (SammyHandelman)

Since you can't use both them and a shield at the same time.

Fix a bug with autopickup display on reload

When reloading the game, we drew the level before reading the init file.
This meant that map information which depends on the rc file didn't
load. This for exampe meant that redundant rings were displayed as
needing autopickup (this is true even with the default init file).

We fix this by doing an extra full draw after reading the init file. It
might be possible to fix it by instead moving the read of the init file
earlier, but this might mess up rc files which rely on the level being
loaded when they are run.

Adjust weights of new demon artefact brands.

The first four brands (chaos, draining, reaping, and vampirism) keep the
highest weights to bias these weapons toward chaos and evil, and
reaping's being more common on demonic artefact weapons thematically
fits. My justification for the others is as follows:

If we assume some of these demons are fighting each other with these,
thematically, antimagic cuts out the biggest advantage many demons have
against other demons (spells); distortion is more dangerous to its
wielders but sends other demons to the Abyss (where they will either be
killed or join Lugonu, become even stronger, and escape); and pain is
least common because it does nothing special to demons but aids demons
with necromancy against their living enemies.

Make demon weapon randart generation more interesting

Currently, demon weapon randarts have a 7/9 chance to generate with a
brand chosen from an unweighted list of mostly non-evil brands. Only 3
out of the 7 brands are actually evil-aligned, and there is about a 50%
chance for any given demon weapon randart to be flaming or freezing.
This commit changes demon weapon randart generation to only apply the
'special' brand override 1/3 of the time, but guarantees that the chosen
brand will be of an evil nature (or antimagic). This should make demon
weapon randart generation a little more thematic and varied.

Actually remove torment immunity from player plants (dilly)

2bbf0e9 only removed immunity from monster plants. Whoops.

Better-inform the player that ?tele is making the Abyssal rune more distant

By giving an additional message when reading ?tele in the Abyss without
having the rune, and also at the end of your teleport, when it pulls them
further away.

Hopefully this will reduce the number of people chain-reading ?tele and
being confused why they never find anything. >.>

Allow setting of base training targets

From the base tab of the skill menu, the player can now set a target for
base skill rather than modified skill. This is useful when e.g. setting
a target for shapeshifting to an amount where you intend to remove
wildshape.

If the skill is modified, targets are only shown on one menu, so that
players can easily distinguish between the two types of target.

Fixes #5029

Fix all cleaving attacks having a to-hit of 0 (dilly)

When 62da445 moved the point where to_hit is calculated, it accidentally
put it in a place that is skipped for cleaving attacks, resulting in them
almost always missing.

It's possible I should reconsider how this is organized, but this ought to
fix the immediate problem, at least.

Mention vampire form's passive daze in the talisman description

It should make the 'Daze Power' listed in the form table slightly less
mysterious to those who don't already know.

Apply Vainglory's conduct even while melded

To avoid people dipping stairs while, say, in medusa form.

(Vainglory's conduct is less severe than Toga of Victory's, but a similar
logic was already used there.)
Be a little more explicit about Hurl Torchlight giving undead energy

Fix redundant messages for eating invisible monsters in Maw form

Now that attacks against invisible monsters generally produce 'the
invisible X' instead of 'something', you would get redundant messages like
"You devour the invisible unseen horror. It tastes like unseen horror."
(What else would it taste like?)

It's a bit hard to actually eat a monster you're not aware of, since you'd
have to one-shot them while being unable to see them, but it's not
impossible...

List current banes in chardumps/morgues (Planckenstein)

I hadn't actually realized they weren't shown there anywhere, until now.
(The listing for mutations in dumps uses a separate codepath than the
mutation menu itself, these days.)

Fix monster Shatter being unaffected by Brilliance and Diminish Magic

(And being a Figment.)
Display monster Shatter damage on xv (Flugkiller)

Don't allow bound enemies to attack things while afraid (knorpule3001)

When 1ea72b2 improved attacking logic for bound enemies in some scenarios,
it also allowed them to ignore some other logic that would have prevented
them from attacking at all, like being afraid.

(Also, they shouldn't become more accurate at attacking the player while
confused or the player is invisible. If they guess the right spot, they'll
still be able to attack, but won't get, essentially, guided aim while
bound.)

Slightly clarify Mask of the Dragon's Dragonpray (confidence interval)

Don't imply that it doesn't work with gods whose skills scale off something
other than Invocations.
Fix werewolf form's howl affecting monsters through glass (canofworms)

Allow stokers to open doors (acrobat)

They're an intelligent, spellcasting skeleton (on the lich glyph, even!).
I'm sure they can figure out a doorknob.

Make player shadows created by Dith wrath a little scarier

They compared pretty poorly to the shadow puppet wrath option.

Attribute player shadows animated by Dith wrath to Dith

Being created in a non-standard way, they didn't get proper blame
attribution.

Remove is_follower()

There was only one use left and it could easily be more specific.

(Good riddance?)

Fix (non-Beogh) god summons not being dismissed on abandonment/penance

*Also* broken since 62137d7 (geeze, there's a lot of that, huh?) where
summoned allies stopped counting as followers for many gods. They didn't
even stop being friendly!

Funnily enough, I think the is_follower() call was redundant here if it
worked as originally intended, so I have just removed it.

(Also, dismiss summons via timeout instead of reset, so it actualy produces
messages and appropriate clouds.)

Don't try to make allies of good god worshippers have rHoly or rFoulFlame-

This hasn't actually done anything since 62137d7 but I don't feel
particularly inclined to put it back. It's a *very* marginal effect.

If we wanted a passive defensive buff to TSO allies, I think rN+++ would be
more interesting (and a lot more relevant).

Fix a convoluted moncast.lua test failure

Even in the test case where both test statues are allies of each other, the
test harness was setting the caster's foe to the other statue.

Allies should not normally be foes of each other, which was leading to an
assert via Grave Claw. Grave Claw's tracer merely checked that the caster
had a visible foe in range (since it can always hit them, if so). And they
did (since their ally was incorrectly set as their foe). But the spell
itself uses the default beam target for its aim, which setup_mons_cast()
*doesn't* set to the position of its foe (since it's not an enemy), leaving
the target at (0, 0).

Casting spells at (0, 0) is often safe, however Grave Claw does damage via
a beam that has a source equal to its target (just as Call Down Lightning
and many other smite-targeted effects do), and a *source* that is out of
boundns (ie: (0, 0)) asserts, causing the test to fail.

This mistake of setting allied foes has been true for moncast.lua possibly
since monsters could ever cast Grave Claw, so why didn't it happen before?
Well, you see, despite having an allied foe, Grave Claw always got vetoed
because the caster couldn't *see* their target since they'd made it
invisible via casting Invisibility Other at some point earlier in the test,
hiding this issue entirely. The crash only started happening now because
they *weren't* successfully making the other statue invisible.

Why weren't they? Because casting Invisibility on themselves was *moving*
them (as was just fixed by the previous commit) and sometimes, depending on
where they moved, a summon created by an earlier spell would now be in the
way of the Invisibility Other beam, preventing them from making their foe
invisible, thus allowing them to actually see them (incorrectly) as a valid
target for Grave Claw, thus crashing.

(This *still* should have been a possible fail state for almost 2 months
now. I can only assume that some unrelated change adjusted the RNG state
by the time it reached this point in the test suite, which allowed Invis to
move the statue in front of a summon when previously it did not.)

Anyway! Now we don't set the other statue as a foe unless they're hostile.

Don't shift immobile monsters after they cast Invisibility

It's not actually a translocation. (And even those shouldn't move literally
stationary monsters.)
Don't Daze the player while already Dazed (or stun-immune)
Remove a stray commented line

Don't make archer monsters spawn with their launcher unequipped

All equipment-using monsters prioritized starting with a melee weapon
equipped, regardless of whether they actually had one or not. This meant
that most archer enemies would spawn unarmed. This was especially
silly-looking for spells that summoned archers, who would arrive seemingly
without a weapon.

(This is the very tiniest of buff to archer monsters, since them wielding
their weapon upon spotting the player only took 2 aut. It's mostly a
visual improvement, for a couple spells in particular.)

Make the was_seen argument of change_monster_type() do something

While setting this to false technically suppressed the *immediated*
encounter message from polymorphing, it still made the monster count as
never seen, which would cause an encounter message to be printed slightly
later anyway.

If we set this to false, we probably want to *actually* suppress such, so
preserve the MF_SEEN flag in this case.

Tweak guardian mummy weapon offset, show shields

And also show weapons for royal mummies. The tile was clearly drawn with
weapon attachments in mind; it baffles me how it went these many years
without them being enabled.

Slightly refactor moving of dynamic map markers

A marginally more elegant solution than 3aa999a

Fix terrain changes that expire on monster death being slightly delayed

8b4cf4e had an oversight that caused the general 'remove linked terrain
changes on monster death' to not actually happen in many cases. But since
linked terrain changes automatically expire at the end of turn if their
source monster isn't alive, it usualy *looked* like it was happening
immediately.

This slight delay (ie: 'at end of turn' versus 'immediately after monster
death') is generally unlikely to have been consequential for most things
up to this point, but slightly incorrect. (And more noticable in
combination with some upcoming monster content.)
